subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Ectopic pregnancy: diagnosis and methotrexate versus surgery

steps.tx: **Ectopic pregnancy** (98 percent tubal, **ampullary** commonest; PID, prior ectopic, IUCD, tubal surgery, ART) presents with **amenorrhoea, pain and bleeding**; **rupture** (syncope, shoulder tip diaphragmatic blood, shock, cervical motion tenderness with adnexal mass) resuscitates with transfusion. Heterotopic with ART twins tricks; interstitial and cornual rupture late catastrophically. Culdocentesis historic; FAST and laparoscopy decide.
steps.say: Missed period pain bleeding with faint shoulder tip is ruptured ectopic: transfuse operate. Ampullary ruptures commonest.

vis.alt: Anatomical diagram showing the uterus, ovaries, and fallopian tubes, with various ectopic pregnancy locations highlighted.
vis.caption: Common and critical locations of ectopic pregnancy

steps.tx: **Diagnosis** (**transvaginal scan**: empty uterus with adnexal mass, free fluid; **discriminatory zone** hCG 1500 to 2000 with no intrauterine sac; **doubling** 48 hours suboptimal rise warns, progesterone low) with **laparoscopy** gold confirms; pregnancy of unknown location follows hCG and scan serially. Pseudogestational sac mimics; corpus luteum confuses. Rh anti-D after all ectopics protects.
steps.say: Empty uterus hCG above 1500 no sac is ectopic until proven: scan serial hCG. Doubling stalls warn.

steps.tx: **Methotrexate** (**single dose** 50 mg per metre square with day 4 and 7 hCG 15 percent fall, **multi dose** with leucovorin; haemodynamically stable, unruptured, sac under 3.5 cm, no significant haemoperitoneum, hCG under 5000, reliable follow up; **no breastfeeding, immunodeficiency, liver, renal, ulcer, active pulmonary TB**) with folinic rescue avoids surgery; rupture, breastfeeding and heterotopic contraindicate. hCG weekly to zero tails.
steps.say: Stable small unruptured low hCG reliable is methotrexate single dose: day 4 7 falls 15 percent. Breastfeeding bans.

steps.tx: **Surgery** (**laparoscopic salpingostomy** fertility preserving with hCG follow up for persistent trophoblast, **salpingectomy** ruptured, recurrent same tube, completed family, uncontrolled bleeding) with **salpingotomy** linear conserves; **expectant** (falling hCG, asymptomatic, reliable) watches selected. Anti-D, counsel future ectopic risk (10 to 15 percent), smoking cessation advises.
steps.say: Ruptured recurrent or bleeding is salpingectomy; fertility keeps salpingostomy hCG watched. Future risk counselled.
